# acme-shop (fixture)

Fictional e-commerce demo repository used by the orrery module's tests.
Nothing here is real: no real company, no real people, no real credentials.

- `web/` - storefront single-page app
- `api/` - checkout worker deployed to an edge platform
- `db/migrations/` - orders schema
- `many/` - 16 small sibling feature dirs (the >12-candidate bucketing fixture)
- `my-app/`, `2fa/`, `Web/` - adversarial area-name dirs for the area-id rule
